name: sideout-purse
description: Sideout, a charity beach volleyball tournament product, on Purse, the competition-infrastructure platform it runs on.

scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @purse/api run db:migrate && pnpm --filter @sideout/web run db:migrate
scripts.db:generate: pnpm --filter @purse/api run db:generate && pnpm --filter @sideout/web run db:generate
